$comment: Differences parity-compare.mjs accepts between a base dump and a head dump. Each entry: path (glob over the difference path; * stays within a segment, ** crosses them), optional kind (value | missing | extra), optional relative or absolute bound (then only numeric value differences inside it match), reason, ticket. A child PR adds the entries its decision accepts, nothing broader.

accepted.reason: Market supply APYs are live: the API re-indexes a market between two dumps taken minutes apart (seen main vs main, 1.6e-4 relative)
Vault APYs are live: a vault accrues between two dumps taken seconds apart (seen 4e-13 on World Chain Re7 USDC, read through unchanged GraphQL code)
Vault APYs are live: a vault accrues between two dumps taken seconds apart (seen 4e-13 on World Chain Re7 USDC, read through unchanged GraphQL code)
Vault V1 history moved to Core REST, whose state/history serves total_assets only: V1 deposits rows carry no USD value (null)
Point counts: the 1W series is Core's seven_days lookback (168 hourly rows); the GraphQL fetch added a 2-day margin (217 rows)
Point counts: the 1M/3M series is Core's ninety_days lookback (94 daily rows); the GraphQL fetch added a 10-day margin (101 rows)

All sampling: Core's inception lookback serves daily rows for the younger V1 vaults (about 7x the points of GraphQL's weekly buckets) and monthly rows for the four oldest V1 vaults (Steakhouse USDC 1:0xBEEF0173, Steakhouse USDT 1:0xbEef047a, Steakhouse RUSD 1:0xBeEf11eC, Moonwell Flagship ETH 8453:0xa0E43087), about 4x coarser

Each dump ends on its own request-time row (a non-aligned timestamp); the head dump, taken seconds later, has a later one. GraphQL also served a trailing hourly bucket with no total assets

Smoothing: GraphQL served the daily-averaged V1 series, Core's apy/history serves its own series for the lookback (as the Vaults app plots it); up to 4.9 percentage points seen. Bounded so a null still fails
